findings: The production native request now constructs core request_adapter::Pending, which owns the one receipt, prepares phase/write authority before native provider construction and invokes both owned effect controllers. Native factories and primitives have no receipt reference, Rc/RefCell bridge or snapshot.

Fourteen actual extracted obligations derive all generic request receipt/readiness contracts, exact returned completion reports, dispatcher and phase/write admission origins, primitive outer freshness/refusal states, consuming-entry receipt reachability and selected-value origin, and a positive final-provider-read witness. Native report/copy/outcome and whole-callback receipt/freshness-frame premises are eliminated for this producer.

Three new core tests cover exact selected values for all three read shapes and keyed writes, every terminal fallible primitive prefix, preparation refusal before any factory, retained send/selection error receipts and replay refusal. Existing native completion fsync/late-revocation and zero/partial/flush writer tests remain green.

The updated optional compiler ledger has nine selected bridge paths, including the new owned request dispatch stage and completion through the actual native audit writer. Forty-seven fixture/capture tests and a fresh bounded compiler capture pass. Unresolved callbacks/dependencies/drop effects remain explicit; complete_mediation=false.

Safe installed-device tests preserve persistent TPM public objects and dictionary-attack state and clean owned fixture handles. Wrong-auth tests use isolated emulators. Native report-link removal does not establish physical TPM custody or deployed isolation.
remaining-obligations: Instantiate native primitive/context and data conversion semantics, current-stamp/event origin and provider/parser/frame/close observations. Selected JSON/canonical encoding and connected adaptive native session/history correspondence remain open.

Non-returning/panic/drop/unwind and transitive callback/dependency/sink closure remain open. The 99-source W3 inventory and source guard are non-exhaustive. Provider Send stage means callback invocation; raw bytes also require the owned composite gate to accept.

NR-2/3/4/5 exit and independent security review, real-provider compatibility and deployed compartment evidence remain open. The checked native request result is conditional on compiler/standard-model correctness and explicit primitive/environment semantics; it is not whole-service mediation or secrecy.
